wood_used_by_crafts.source: ES craft + toolkit + build_well status=success, inventory_delta: -(logs + planks/4 + sticks/8) per row, floored at 0

cobble_placed_in_builds.source: ES _plinth_step place rows with block=cobblestone|cobbled_deepslate (the SAME rows as plinth_blocks_placed, by material -- not additive) + cobble the build verb spent

iron_used_by_toolkit.source: ES _toolkit phase=kit used= (ingots the verified crafts consumed; args, else detail)

bot_hours_online.source: ES coverage(): (bot, hour) pairs with >= 1 document, edge hours pro-rated
bot_hours_online.note: equals the nominal bots x hours whenever every bot logs in every hour (it does: the bots log many rows a minute); it falls below that only when a bot is down

bot_hours_alive.source: online bot-hours less, per death, the gap to that bot's next ES document after death+1 s (capped 60 min)
bot_hours_alive.note: bots respawn automatically, so alive ~ online; the gap is what the logs can show

survival_streaks.source: ES _death rows from 2026-10-08T00:00:00Z (deduplicated by bot+time); wall-clock, not online time
survival_streaks.note: current streak is capped at the window start, so the median is comparable day to day only between full 7-day windows (10-14 onward)

town_deposits_ok.source: ES town_deposit status=success (the skill row; _town_deposit is the same run)

town_withdrawals_ok.source: ES withdraw_pick (a town verb) + withdraw (generic: only with bot.pos within 53 blocks (x,z) and 17 (y) of its world's home (homes from the census files: 16 worlds)), status=success

items_into_town_chests.note: generic deposit/withdraw rows count only with bot.pos within 53 blocks (x,z) and 17 (y) of its world's home (homes from the census files: 16 worlds) (40 deposit and 4 withdraw rows outside were excluded). in: items leaving bags on successful town_deposit/deposit rows (inventory_delta < 0) + smelt_town dep_i; out: items entering bags on successful withdraw_pick/withdraw (delta > 0) + toolkit drew/sticks + smelt_town raw copper withdrawn and NOT banked back (in counts only its ingots, dep_i; the raw round trip is reported as smelt_town_raw_round_trip_excluded). _stock_bank (deposit() sub-rows) is NOT added. A deposit row's delta can include a dirt/cobble loss in the same run, so "in" is an upper bound per row and a lower bound overall (reflex banking has no skill row)

items_out_of_town_chests.note: generic deposit/withdraw rows count only with bot.pos within 53 blocks (x,z) and 17 (y) of its world's home (homes from the census files: 16 worlds) (40 deposit and 4 withdraw rows outside were excluded). in: items leaving bags on successful town_deposit/deposit rows (inventory_delta < 0) + smelt_town dep_i; out: items entering bags on successful withdraw_pick/withdraw (delta > 0) + toolkit drew/sticks + smelt_town raw copper withdrawn and NOT banked back (in counts only its ingots, dep_i; the raw round trip is reported as smelt_town_raw_round_trip_excluded). _stock_bank (deposit() sub-rows) is NOT added. A deposit row's delta can include a dirt/cobble loss in the same run, so "in" is an upper bound per row and a lower bound overall (reflex banking has no skill row)

pickaxes_fetched.source: ES withdraw_pick status=success, *_pickaxe inventory_delta > 0 (the verb also fetches sticks: not counted here)

kit_tools_from_town_iron.source: ES _toolkit phase=kit crafted= (verified new usable copies; the toolkit draws only TOWN iron, toolkit.mjs kitDraw)

kit_tools_from_bag_iron.source: ES craft status=success args.item=iron_axe|iron_shovel (the model's own craft, from the bag)

wells_shared.source: ES _well_dispose status=success, distinct bot.name per well (as wells_in_use locates them)
